[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Carria''' was a member of [[House Cadriaan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She led the House's [[privy council]], and appointed Lady [[Areilla Nastascha]] to the council when Lady [[Bathos]] ascended to lead the House.<ref name="LE" />
